description: The network around a product as nodes and edges: connected products (engine part of vehicle, launched on, heritage, built on, successor), the organizations (makers, suppliers, operators), the materials, and for the product and its direct neighbours also the parts with their material and supplier. Use it to follow a chain: vehicle -> stage -> engine -> part -> material -> supplier, for example product_graph of the Space Launch System at depth 2. Every edge carries its relation, role, status, quote and source. Nodes of type unresolved are names a source gave that are not products here yet. depth is the number of product-to-product hops (0 to 3, default 1). For depth 2 or more consider include_parts false to keep the answer small. No edge means not recorded, not absent.

include_parts.description: Include parts (with material and supplier) of the product and its direct neighbours

name: product_graph
